messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#4692 — hosted-inference-eu-west1 — 5xx spike (>22% over last 2m). Auto-suppression: off.
pagerbot: Paging: @dmitri (primary oncall), @caroline (eu region). Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/PD4692 :rotating_light:
Dmitri: acked via PagerDuty (oncall). I'll take initial triage.
Caroline: taking regional ownership — checking routing and model variants.
Dmitri: tl;dr — burst of 502/504s from inference-proxy in eu-west1 starting 2:23 UTC; latency also up ~3x. No other regions yet.
Alice: +1 on proxy — saw errors in logs: "upstream read timeout" repeated.
Ben: adding metrics link: https://grafana.redwood/boards/CPU-inference-eu-west1 (spike aligns with deploy at 02:22).
Dmitri: can someone `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` in eu-west1? suspecting rolling deploy + liveness flaps.
Caroline: running now — pods: inference-proxy-0/1/2, one pod RestartCount=6. Node memory looks fine.
Caroline: command output: ```
NAME                          READY  STATUS   RESTARTS
inference-proxy-0             1/1    Running 6
inference-proxy-1             1/1    Running 0
inference-proxy-2             1/1    Running 0
```
Dmitri: heavy restart on -0 suggests bad image or drain. Rolling deploy ID: sha:7a1b2c. Who kicked that?
Alice: I kicked a canary earlier for a small header change at 02:21 — didn't expect proxy to drop. Rolling out full at 02:22 was my mistake, sorry.
Dmitri: ok — rollback to sha:6f9d8e now. Caroline, can you flip routing to fallback pool while rollback completes? We want to limit customer impact.
Caroline: switching routing rule to fallback pool now (will route new requests to dedicated-fallback, preserving warm KV cache when possible).
Caroline: `done` — new requests to fallback for eu-west1. Latency back to baseline for small subset of traffic.
Ben: alerting SLO monitoring team — will mark partial customer impact. Reaching out to support to add a banner if needed.
Dmitri: rollback in progress — `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-proxy --to-revision=6` (started). ETA ~45s per pod.
Alice: monitoring logs; will stop rollout if errors persist. Really sorry, taking postmortem.
Caroline: can we keep PD on for now until we confirm 5xx drop below 1% for 5m?
Dmitri: agreed — keep paging enabled. I'll stay as primary until handoff confirmed.
Ben: support notified — CS on standby for high-volume customers.
Caroline: metrics show 5xx down to 3% and trending. Fallback pool holding ~15% traffic.
Dmitri: 5xx now 0.8% over last 1m. Rolling undo finished, pods stable. I'm removing escalation to on-call rotation; will hand back to normal.
Dmitri: final checks: no customer errors in top-10 tenants; will close PD in 5m if stable.
Alice: logged deploy mistake and brief runbook notes in #eng-releases.
Ben: adding incident note: partial customer impact — mitigation: rollback + fallback routing.
Caroline: leaving one watch window for 10m. If no regression, we mark resolved. :white_check_mark: 
Dmitri: thanks all. Closing notes to follow.
incidentbot: PD#4692 updated: status=acknowledged, owner=dmitri, severity=major, mitigations=rollback,fallback-routing.
pagerbot: PD#4692 will auto-resolve after 10m of stable metrics.
Dmitri: marking this thread for postmortem; assigning to Alice for follow-up.
Alice: will draft postmortem and link to runbook edits.
Caroline: leaving channel but reachable if needed — thanks.
